events.text: Construction of the new werk (tower) started

evidence.quote: The construction of the new werk was started in 1300

events.text: Tower construction completed after ten years

evidence.quote: It was completed after ten years in 1310
Completed in 1310

events.text: Original lead roof replaced by copper roof

evidence.quote: was replaced by copper in 1474

events.text: Copper roof replaced by a tiled roof

evidence.quote: This was again replaced in 1558 by a tiled roof

events.label: lighthouse
events.text: Tower turned into a lighthouse

evidence.quote: The tower was only turned into a lighthouse on December 20 , 1814
used as lighthouse ( 1814–2014 )

events.label: triangulation point
events.text: Tower used as northernmost measuring point for Hannover triangulation by Gauss

evidence.quote: by Carl Friedrich Gauss in July 1825

events.text: Lamp began burning colza oil and kerosene

evidence.quote: burned on colza oil and kerosene starting 1870

events.text: Fresnel lens installed in the lighthouse lamp

evidence.quote: A fresnel lens of measuring a focal length of 700 mm was installed 1892

events.text: Lighthouse lamp improved

evidence.quote: The lamp was again improved in 1908

events.text: Roof copper used for military purposes

evidence.quote: The copper was then used for military purposes in 1916

events.label: hostel use
events.text: Use as a hostel for Winterhude schools initiated by Heinrich Gechter

evidence.quote: initiated the use as a hostel for schools of Winterhude in 1920

events.label: heritage protection
events.text: Tower placed under cultural heritage protection

evidence.quote: The tower is protected under cultural heritage management since 1924

events.text: Hostel moved to the neighboring barn

evidence.quote: which switched to the neighboring barn 1924

events.text: Lighthouse lamp first electrified

evidence.quote: to be first electrified in 1942

events.text: Kerosene lamp upgraded to propane

evidence.quote: upgraded to propane in 1949

events.text: Electric lamp replaced by a halogen lamp (autumn)

evidence.quote: replaced by a Halogen lamp in fall 2007

events.label: decommissioning
events.text: Lighthouse decommissioned as non-essential for shipping

evidence.quote: it was decommissioned on January 1 , 2014

events.text: Lighthouse turned over to the Hamburg Port Authority

evidence.quote: decommissioned on January 1 , 2014 and turned over to the Hamburg Port Authority

events.text: Lighthouse lamp replaced by LED

evidence.quote: On February 10 , 2014 it was replaced by LED

events.label: lighthouse closure
events.text: Lighthouse officially shut down; continues as a private light

evidence.quote: On February 10 , 2014 it was officially shut down
